title: Narrow-terminal adaptation
user_prompt: Refactor an existing multi-region terminal screen so it remains usable in a small terminal. Preserve the primary content and its most important action; reduce secondary metadata, wrap, scroll, or switch layout deliberately instead of squeezing every panel into one line. Support 40x12 as the compact case and 80x24 as the common case.

acceptance_checks.assertion: The primary action and current task state remain discoverable at compact width/height.
Secondary content degrades deliberately through wrapping, scrolling, or omission with an accessible detail path.
Manual text-width calculations use terminal display width or layout primitives rather than JavaScript string length.
Essential controls and their key hints are not silently clipped out of view.

hard_gates.failure_condition: A required action disappears at compact sizes without an alternate access path.
Manual width calculations use JavaScript string length for display-cell alignment with potentially wide/combining text.
